title: Madhya-khanda, part 17 (portion 40)
html:
The section "The Lord's Sannyasa" (conclusion): the Lord has His head shaved and receives the sannyasa mantra from Keshava Bharati; a voice from the sky names Him Sri Krishna Chaitanya; night kirtana with the guru; farewell to Bharati; three days absorbed in prema in Radha-desha; the Lord sends Chandrashekhara back to Navadvipa

পুনরপি ন্যাসিবরে করয়ে প্রণাম ।
আপন অন্তরকথা মাগয়ে বিধান ॥ ১১৩ ॥

punarapi nyāsibare karaẏe praṇāma |
āpana antarakathā māgaẏe bidhāna || 113 ||

punarapi — again; nyasivare karaye pranama — He bows to the best of sannyasis; apana antara-katha — [telling] what is in His heart; magaye vidhana — asks for the prescribed procedure

113Again He bows to the best of sannyasis,
opens His heart to him and asks to be instructed in the rite.

তার পর-দিনে প্রভু গুরু-আজ্ঞা লঞা ।
সন্ন্যাস-বিধান-কর্ম করয়ে হাসিয়া ॥ ১১৪ ॥

tāra para-dine prabhu guru-ājñā lañā |
sannyāsa-bidhāna-karma karaẏe hāsiẏā || 114 ||

tara para-dine — on the next day; prabhu guru-ajna lanya — the Lord, taking the guru's leave; sannyasa-vidhana-karma — the rites prescribed for sannyasa; karaye hasiya — performs smiling

114The next day the Lord, taking the guru's leave,
smilingly performs the rites prescribed for sannyasa.

করিল সকল কর্ম যে ছিল বিহিত ।
'সন্ন্যাস করিব' বলি' আনন্দিত চিত ॥ ১১৫ ॥

karila sakala karma ye chila bihita |
'sannyāsa kariba' bali' ānandita cita || 115 ||

karila sakala karma — He performed all the rites; ye chhila vihita — that were prescribed; sannyasa kariba bali — saying "I shall take sannyasa"; anandita chita — with a joyful heart

115He performed all the prescribed rites,
His heart rejoicing: "I shall take sannyasa!"

আপনে আচার্যরত্ন কৃষ্ণপূজা করে ।
চৌদিগে বৈষ্ণব সব হরি হরি বোলে ॥ ১১৬ ॥

āpane ācāryaratna kṛṣṇapūjā kare |
caudige baiṣṇaba saba hari hari bole || 116 ||

apane acharyaratna — Acharyaratna himself; krishna-puja kare — performs the worship of Krishna; chaudige vaishnava saba — all around, the Vaishnavas; hari hari bole — say "Hari, Hari!"

116Acharyaratna himself performs the worship of Krishna,1
and all around the Vaishnavas cry, "Hari, Hari!"

গুরুর সম্মুখে রহে পুটাঞ্জলি করি' ।
মাগয়ে সন্ন্যাস-মন্ত্র প্রণাম করি' ॥ ১১৭ ॥

gurura sammukhe rahe puṭāñjali kari' |
māgaẏe sannyāsa-mantra praṇāma kari' || 117 ||

gurura sammukhe rahe — He stands before the guru; putanjali kari — with joined palms; magaye sannyasa-mantra — asks for the sannyasa mantra; pranama kari — bowing

117With joined palms [the Lord] stands before the guru
and, bowing, asks for the sannyasa mantra.

মুণ্ডন করিল প্রভু — শুন তার কথা ।
যা শুনিলে সভার হৃদয়ে লাগে ব্যথা ॥ ১১৮ ॥

muṇḍana karila prabhu — śuna tāra kathā |
yā śunile sabhāra hṛdaẏe lāge byathā || 118 ||

mundana karila prabhu — the Lord had His head shaved; shuna tara katha — hear the account of it; ya shunile — hearing which; sabhara hridaye lage vyatha — everyone's heart aches

118The Lord had His head shaved — hear of it:
the heart of everyone who hears it aches.

সকল বৈষ্ণবজনে লাগে হিয়া-কাঁপ ।
মুণ্ডনের কালে বস্ত্রে মুখে দেই ঝাঁপ ॥ ১১৯ ॥

sakala baiṣṇabajane lāge hiẏā-kāṁpa |
muṇḍanera kāle bastre mukhe dei jhāṁpa || 119 ||

sakala vaishnava-jane — in all the Vaishnavas; lage hiya-kanpa — the heart trembles; mundanera kale — at the time of shaving; vastre mukhe dei jhanpa — they cover their faces with cloth

119The hearts of all the Vaishnavas trembled:
while He was being shaved, they covered their faces with cloth.

কমলা-লালিত কেশ ত্রৈলোক্যসুন্দর ।
মালার সহিত নাম্বে এ গজকন্ধর ॥ ১২০ ॥

kamalā-lālita keśa trailokyasundara |
mālāra sahita nāmbe e gajakandhara || 120 ||

kamala-lalita kesha — the hair cherished by Kamala (Lakshmi); trailokya-sundara — the most beautiful in the three worlds; malara sahita — together with the garland; nambe e gaja-kandhara — flowing down to these elephant-like shoulders

120The hair cherished by Kamala, the most beautiful in the three worlds,
which with the garland flowed down to His shoulders, mighty as an elephant's;

পূরুবে চূড়ার বেশে মোহিল জগত ।
যাহার ধেয়ানে জীয়ে সকল ভকত ॥ ১২১ ॥

pūrube cūṛāra beśe mohila jagata |
yāhāra dheẏāne jīẏe sakala bhakata || 121 ||

purube — formerly; chudara veshe — dressed in a chuda (topknot with peacock feather); mohila jagata — enchanted the world; yahara dheyane — by meditation on which; jiye sakala bhakata — all devotees live

121which once, dressed in a chuda, enchanted the world,2 —
by meditating on it all the devotees live;

গোপবধূ যাহা লাগি' ছাড়িলেক লাজ ।
জাতি-কুল-শীল-ভয়ে পাড়িলেক বাজ ॥ ১২২ ॥

gopabadhū yāhā lāgi' chāṛileka lāja |
jāti-kula-śīla-bhaẏe pāṛileka bāja || 122 ||

gopa-vadhu yaha lagi — for whose sake the cowherd wives; chhadileka laja — gave up shyness; jati-kula-shila-bhaye — on the fear of caste, family and conduct; padileka baja — brought down a thunderbolt (cast it off)

122for its sake the cowherd wives gave up their modesty
and shattered, as with a thunderbolt, their fear for caste, family and good name;

যার গুণগানে শিব, বিরিঞ্চি, নারদ ।
আপনারে ধন্য মানে — সকল সম্পদ ॥ ১২৩ ॥

yāra guṇagāne śiba, biriñci, nārada |
āpanāre dhanya māne — sakala sampada || 123 ||

yara guna-gane — in singing their glory; shiva virinchi narada — Shiva, Brahma, Narada; apanare dhanya mane — consider themselves blessed; sakala sampada — [it is] all their wealth

123singing its glory, Shiva, Brahma and Narada
count themselves blessed — it is all their wealth.

হেন কেশ মুণ্ডন করিতে চাহে পহুঁ ।
কান্দয়ে সকল লোক — না তুলয়ে মুহুঁ ॥ ১২৪ ॥

hena keśa muṇḍana karite cāhe pahuṁ |
kāndaẏe sakala loka — nā tulaẏe muhuṁ || 124 ||

hena kesha — such hair; mundana karite chahe pahun — the Lord wishes to shave off; kandaye sakala loka — all the people weep; na tulaye muhun — they do not raise their faces

124Such hair the Lord wishes to shave off, —
all the people weep and do not raise their faces.

নাপিত আনিয়া বৈল বচন বিনয় ।
কৃষ্ণ ভজি' তুমি মোর হও ত সহায় ॥ ১২৪+১ ॥

nāpita āniẏā baila bacana binaẏa |
kṛṣṇa bhaji' tumi mora hao ta sahāẏa || 124+1 ||

napita aniya — bringing a barber; baila bachana vinaya — He spoke humble words; krishna bhaji — in worshipping Krishna; tumi mora hao ta sahaya — be My helper

124+1Calling a barber, [the Lord] spoke to him humbly:3
"Help Me in the service of Krishna.

আমি ত সন্ন্যাসী হৈয়া কৃষ্ণের হইব ।
মস্তক মুণ্ডন কর — তোর ভাগ্য হব ॥ ১২৪+২ ॥

āmi ta sannyāsī haiẏā kṛṣṇera haiba |
mastaka muṇḍana kara — tora bhāgya haba || 124+2 ||

ami ta sannyasi haiya — I, becoming a sannyasi; krishnera haiba — shall become Krishna's; mastaka mundana kara — shave My head; tora bhagya haba — it will be your good fortune

124+2Becoming a sannyasi, I shall belong to Krishna:
shave My head — it will be your good fortune."

নাপিত না দেই হাথ শিরের উপরে ।
তরাসে তাহার অঙ্গ করে থরথরে ॥ ১২৫ ॥

nāpita nā dei hātha śirera upare |
tarāse tāhāra aṅga kare tharathare || 125 ||

napita na dei hatha — the barber does not put his hand; shirera upare — on the head; tarase — out of fear; tahara anga kare tharathare — his body trembles

125The barber does not put his hand on His head:
his whole body trembles with fear.

মোর ভাগ্য নাই প্রভু, যাই সর্বথায় ।
কেমনে বা হাত দিব তোমার মাথায় ॥ ১২৫+১ ॥

mora bhāgya nāi prabhu, yāi sarbathāẏa |
kemane bā hāta diba tomāra māthāẏa || 125+1 ||

mora bhagya nai prabhu — I have no fortune, Lord; yai sarvathaya — I am utterly lost; kemane va hata diba — how shall I put my hand; tomara mathaya — on Your head

125+1"I have no such fortune, Lord, — I am utterly lost:4
how can I put my hand on Your head?

যদি মোর কুষ্ঠ হই' গলুক সব অঙ্গ ।
কংসে নরকে যাই — শুনহ গৌরাঙ্গ ॥ ১২৫+২ ॥

yadi mora kuṣṭha hai' galuka saba aṅga |
kaṃse narake yāi — śunaha gaurāṅga || 125+2 ||

yadi mora kushtha hai — even if I get leprosy; galuka saba anga — let all my limbs rot; kamse narake yai — let me go to hell like Kamsa; shunaha gauranga — hear, Gauranga

125+2Let me get leprosy and all my body rot away,
let me go to hell like Kamsa, — hear me, Gauranga, —

তথাপি তোমার শিরে হাত দিতে নারি ।
বিনয় করিয়া বলি — শুন গৌরহরি ॥ ১২৫+৩ ॥

tathāpi tomāra śire hāta dite nāri |
binaẏa kariẏā bali — śuna gaurahari || 125+3 ||

tathapi — even so; tomara shire hata dite nari — I cannot put my hand on Your head; vinaya kariya bali — I say humbly; shuna gaurahari — hear, Gaurahari

125+3still I cannot put my hand on Your head:
humbly I tell You, hear me, Gaurahari."

কণ্টকনগরের লোক এ নারী-পুরুষে ।
ফুকরি' ফুকরি' কান্দে সকরুণ ভাষে ॥ ১২৬ ॥

kaṇṭakanagarera loka e nārī-puruṣe |
phukari' phukari' kānde sakaruṇa bhāṣe || 126 ||

kantaka-nagarera loka — the people of Kantakanagara; e nari-purushe — women and men; phukari phukari kande — weep aloud; sakaruna bhashe — in piteous voices

126The people of Kantakanagara, women and men,
weep aloud in piteous voices.

নাপিত কহয়ে — প্রভু, নিবেদি চরণে ।
তোর শিরে হাথ দিব কাহার পরাণে ॥ ১২৭ ॥

nāpita kahaẏe — prabhu, nibedi caraṇe |
tora śire hātha diba kāhāra parāṇe || 127 ||

napita kahaye — the barber says; prabhu nivedi charane — Lord, I submit at Your feet; tora shire hatha diba — to put my hand on Your head; kahara parane — with whose heart (how could I dare)

127The barber says: "Lord, I pray at Your feet:
how could I dare to put my hand on Your head?

আমার শকতি নাহি করিতে মুণ্ডন ।
সুন্দর কুঞ্চিত কেশ ত্রৈলোক্য-মোহন ॥ ১২৮ ॥

āmāra śakati nāhi karite muṇḍana |
sundara kuñcita keśa trailokya-mohana || 128 ||

amara shakati nahi — I have no power; karite mundana — to shave; sundara kunchita kesha — the beautiful curling hair; trailokya-mohana — enchanting the three worlds

128I have no strength to shave off
this beautiful curling hair that enchants the three worlds.

দেখিতে শীতল হয় হৃদয়-নয়ন ।
যে কর সে কর প্রভু, না কর মুণ্ডন ॥ ১২৯ ॥

dekhite śītala haẏa hṛdaẏa-naẏana |
ye kara se kara prabhu, nā kara muṇḍana || 129 ||

dekhite — on seeing [it]; shitala haya hridaya-nayana — heart and eyes are cooled; ye kara se kara prabhu — do what You will, Lord; na kara mundana — do not shave

129One look at it brings coolness to heart and eyes.
Do whatever You will, Lord, only do not shave it.

এরূপ মানুষ নাই জগত-ভিতর ।
তুমি সর্বলোকনাথ — জানিল অন্তর ॥ ১৩০ ॥

erūpa mānuṣa nāi jagata-bhitara |
tumi sarbalokanātha — jānila antara || 130 ||

e-rupa manusha nai — there is no such man; jagata-bhitara — in the world; tumi sarvaloka-natha — You are the Lord of all worlds; janila antara — my heart has understood

130There is no one in the world like You:
You are the Lord of all the worlds — my heart has understood."

এ বোল শুনিঞা প্রভু অসন্তোষ পায় ।
বুঝিয়া নাপিত কাজ অন্তরে ডরায় ॥ ১৩১ ॥

e bola śuniñā prabhu asantoṣa pāẏa |
bujhiẏā nāpita kāja antare ḍarāẏa || 131 ||

e bola shuninya — hearing these words; prabhu asantosha paya — the Lord is displeased; bujhiya napita kaja — the barber, understanding this; antare daraya — is frightened at heart

131Hearing these words, the Lord is displeased;
seeing this, the barber grows afraid at heart

পুনঃ নিবেদন করে অন্তরে কাতর ।
কেমনে বা হাথ দিব এ শির-উপর ॥ ১৩২ ॥

punaḥ nibedana kare antare kātara |
kemane bā hātha diba e śira-upara || 132 ||

punah nivedana kare — again he pleads; antare katara — distressed at heart; kemane va hatha diba — how shall I put my hand; e shira-upara — on this head

132and pleads again, distressed within:
"How shall I put my hand on this head?

অপরাধ লাগি' মোর ডরে হালে গা ।
তোর শিরে হাথ দিয়া ছোঁব কার পা ॥ ১৩৩ ॥

aparādha lāgi' mora ḍare hāle gā |
tora śire hātha diẏā choṁba kāra pā || 133 ||

aparadha lagi — for fear of offence; mora dare hale ga — my body shakes with fear; tora shire hatha diya — having touched Your head; chhonba kara pa — whose feet shall I touch

133I fear to offend — my body shakes with fear:
having touched Your head, whose feet shall I touch afterwards?5

কার পায় হাথ দিয়া করিব নিজবৃত্তি ।
অধম নাপিত মুঞি হঙ ছার জাতি ॥ ১৩৪ ॥

kāra pāẏa hātha diẏā kariba nijabṛtti |
adhama nāpita muñi haṅa chāra jāti || 134 ||

kara paya hatha diya — touching whose feet; kariba nija-vritti — shall I ply my trade; adhama napita munni — I am a lowly barber; hanga chhara jati — of a wretched caste

134Touching whose feet shall I ply my trade?
I am a lowly barber, of a wretched caste."

এ বোল শুনিঞা প্রভু সদয়-হৃদয় ।
না করিহ বৃত্তি তুমি — ঠাকুর কহয় ॥ ১৩৫ ॥

e bola śuniñā prabhu sadaẏa-hṛdaẏa |
nā kariha bṛtti tumi — ṭhākura kahaẏa || 135 ||

e bola shuninya — hearing this; prabhu sadaya-hridaya — the Lord, compassionate at heart; na kariha vritti tumi — do not ply your trade; thakura kahaya — says the Lord

135Hearing this, the compassionate Lord
says: "Ply your trade no more."

প্রভু বলে — শুন রে নাপিত হরিদাস ।
মুণ্ডন করহ, আমি করিব সন্ন্যাস ॥ ১৩৫+১ ॥

prabhu bale — śuna re nāpita haridāsa |
muṇḍana karaha, āmi kariba sannyāsa || 135+1 ||

prabhu bale — the Lord says; shuna re napita haridasa — listen, Haridasa the barber; mundana karaha — shave [Me]; ami kariba sannyasa — I shall take sannyasa

135+1The Lord says:6 "Listen, Haridasa the barber:
shave Me — I shall take sannyasa.

কৃষ্ণের প্রসাদে জন্ম সুখে গোঙাইবে ।
অন্তকালে বাস তোর মোর লোকে হবে ॥ ১৩৬ ॥

kṛṣṇera prasāde janma sukhe goṅāibe |
antakāle bāsa tora mora loke habe || 136 ||

krishnera prasade — by Krishna's grace; janma sukhe gongaibe — you will pass your life happily; anta-kale — at the end; vasa tora mora loke habe — your dwelling will be in My abode

136By Krishna's grace you will pass your life happily,
and at the end your dwelling will be in My abode.

আমার মুণ্ডন করি' যত অস্ত্রগণ ।
গঙ্গাজল-মাঝে লৈয়া কর সমর্পণ ॥ ১৩৬+১ ॥

āmāra muṇḍana kari' yata astragaṇa |
gaṅgājala-mājhe laiẏā kara samarpaṇa || 136+1 ||

amara mundana kari — having shaved Me; yata astragana — all the instruments; ganga-jala-majhe laiya — taking them into the Ganga's waters; kara samarpana — consign them

136+1Having shaved Me, take all the instruments7
and give them over to the waters of the Ganga."

শুনি' হরিদাস মনে ভাবিতে লাগিল ।
আমার মঙ্গল কর্ম কভু না হইল ॥ ১৩৬+২ ॥

śuni' haridāsa mane bhābite lāgila |
āmāra maṅgala karma kabhu nā haila || 136+2 ||

shuni haridasa — hearing, Haridasa; mane bhavite lagila — began to think; amara mangala karma — an auspicious deed for me; kabhu na haila — has never come

136+2Hearing this, Haridasa began to think:
"No good lot ever falls to me:

মুণ্ডন করিয়া যদি তবুহ বিনাশ ।
মুণ্ডন না কৈলেও মোর হবে সর্বনাশ ॥ ১৩৬+৩ ॥

muṇḍana kariẏā yadi tabuha bināśa |
muṇḍana nā kaileo mora habe sarbanāśa || 136+3 ||

mundana kariya yadi — if I shave; tabuha vinasha — still ruin; mundana na kaileo — and if I do not shave; mora habe sarvanasha — I shall be utterly ruined

136+3if I shave Him — ruin all the same,
and if I do not shave Him — I am undone.

ইঁহারে পিরীতি করি' — যে হয় সে হোক ।
ধর্মাধর্ম-পরমাত্মা এই পরতেক ॥ ১৩৬+৪ ॥

iṁhāre pirīti kari' — ye haẏa se hoka |
dharmādharma-paramātmā ei parateka || 136+4 ||

inhare piriti kari — out of love for Him; ye haya se hoka — come what may; dharmadharma-paramatma — the Supreme Self, [arbiter of] dharma and adharma; ei parateka — here He is, manifest

136+4I will do it out of love for Him — come what may:
here He is before my eyes — the Supreme Self, who rules dharma and adharma."

মুণ্ডনের কালে সে নাপিতে বর পায় ।
কাতর-হৃদয়ে এ লোচন দাস গায় ॥ ১৩৭ ॥

muṇḍanera kāle se nāpite bara pāẏa |
kātara-hṛdaẏe e locana dāsa gāẏa || 137 ||

mundanera kale — at the time of shaving; se napite vara paya — that barber receives a boon; katara-hridaye — with a stricken heart; e lochana dasa gaya — this Lochana Dasa sings

137At the time of the shaving that barber received a blessing;
with a stricken heart Lochana Dasa sings of it.

Raga purabi-sindhura

মুণ্ডন করিল প্রভু দেখি' শুভক্ষণে ।
সন্ন্যাস করয়ে শুভদিনে সংক্রমণে ॥ ১৩৮ ॥

muṇḍana karila prabhu dekhi' śubhakṣaṇe |
sannyāsa karaẏe śubhadine saṃkramaṇe || 138 ||

mundana karila prabhu — the Lord had His head shaved; dekhi shubha-kshane — choosing an auspicious moment; sannyasa karaye — takes sannyasa; shubha-dine sankramane — on the auspicious day of the sankranti (the sun's transit)

138Choosing an auspicious moment, the Lord had His head shaved
and takes sannyasa on the auspicious day of the sankranti.

মকর লেউটে কুম্ভ আইসে হেন বেলে ।
সন্ন্যাসের মন্ত্র গুরু কহে হেনকালে ॥ ১৩৯ ॥

makara leuṭe kumbha āise hena bele |
sannyāsera mantra guru kahe henakāle || 139 ||

makara leute — [when the sun] turns from Makara (Capricorn); kumbha aise — and enters Kumbha (Aquarius); hena bele — at such an hour; sannyasera mantra guru kahe — the guru speaks the sannyasa mantra; hena-kale — at that time

139At the hour when [the sun] leaves Makara and enters Kumbha,8
the guru speaks the sannyasa mantra.

চৌদিগে বৈষ্ণবগণ করে সংকীর্তনে ।
মন্ত্র কহে ন্যাসী বিশ্বম্ভরের শ্রবণে ॥ ১৪০ ॥

caudige baiṣṇabagaṇa kare saṃkīrtane |
mantra kahe nyāsī biśbambharera śrabaṇe || 140 ||

chaudige vaishnava-gana — all around the Vaishnavas; kare sankirtane — perform sankirtana; mantra kahe nyasi — the sannyasi speaks the mantra; vishvambharera shravane — into Vishvambhara's ear

140All around, the Vaishnavas perform sankirtana,
and the sannyasi speaks the mantra into Vishvambhara's ear.

মন্ত্র পাঞা বিশ্বম্ভর পুলকিত-অঙ্গ ।
শতগুণ বাঢ়ে কৃষ্ণপ্রেমার তরঙ্গ ॥ ১৪১ ॥

mantra pāñā biśbambhara pulakita-aṅga |
śataguṇa bāṛhe kṛṣṇapremāra taraṅga || 141 ||

mantra panya — receiving the mantra; vishvambhara pulakita-anga — Vishvambhara's body thrills; shataguna badhe — swell a hundredfold; krishna-premara taranga — the waves of love for Krishna

141Receiving the mantra, Vishvambhara thrilled all over:
the waves of love for Krishna swelled a hundredfold.

অরুণ-নয়নে জল ঝরে অনিবার ।
ক্ষণে মালসাট মারে, ছাড়ে হুহুঙ্কার ॥ ১৪২ ॥

aruṇa-naẏane jala jhare anibāra |
kṣaṇe mālasāṭa māre, chāṛe huhuṅkāra || 142 ||

aruna-nayane — from the reddened eyes; jala jhare anivara — tears flow ceaselessly; kshane malasata mare — now He slaps His arms; chhade huhunkara — lets out a roar

142From His reddened eyes tears flow ceaselessly;
now He slaps His arms, now He lets out a roar.

'সন্ন্যাস করিল' ইহা বলিয়া উল্লাস ।
পুনঃ পুনঃ প্রেমানন্দে অট্ট-অট্ট হাস ॥ ১৪৩ ॥

'sannyāsa karila' ihā baliẏā ullāsa |
punaḥ punaḥ premānande aṭṭa-aṭṭa hāsa || 143 ||

sannyasa karila — "I have taken sannyasa!"; iha baliya ullasa — saying this, He exults; punah punah premanande — again and again in the bliss of prema; atta-atta hasa — laughs aloud

143"I have taken sannyasa!" He says, exulting,
and again and again laughs aloud in the bliss of prema.9

কাঞ্চননগরের সে রূপ দেখিয়া ।
নিশ্চয় জানিল এই রাসবিনোদিয়া ॥ ১৪৩+১ ॥

kāñcananagarera se rūpa dekhiẏā |
niścaẏa jānila ei rāsabinodiẏā || 143+1 ||

kanchana-nagarera — [the people] of Kanchananagara; se rupa dekhiya — seeing that beauty; nishchaya janila — knew for certain; ei rasa-vinodiya — this is He who delights in the rasa dance

143+1[The people] of Kanchananagara, seeing that beauty,10
knew for certain: this is He who delights in the rasa dance.

ভক্তগণ মুখ হেরি' নাচয়ে আনন্দে ।
আপনে ঠাকুর নাচে, নাচে নিত্যানন্দে ॥ ১৪৩+২ ॥

bhaktagaṇa mukha heri' nācaẏe ānande |
āpane ṭhākura nāce, nāce nityānande || 143+2 ||

bhakta-gana mukha heri — the devotees, gazing at [His] face; nachaye anande — dance in bliss; apane thakura nache — the Lord Himself dances; nache nityanande — Nityananda dances

143+2Gazing at His face, the devotees dance in bliss;
the Lord Himself dances, Nityananda dances.

করতাল মৃদঙ্গ আর কীর্তনের রোল ।
চৌদিগে সকল লোক বলে হরিবোল ॥ ১৪৩+৩ ॥

karatāla mṛdaṅga āra kīrtanera rola |
caudige sakala loka bale haribola || 143+3 ||

karatala mridanga — cymbals, mridangas; ara kirtanera rola — and the roar of kirtana; chaudige sakala loka — all around, all the people; bale haribola — cry "Haribol!"

143+3Cymbals ring, mridangas sound, the kirtana roars,
and all the people around cry, "Haribol!"

নটবর-শেখর সুঘড় সহচর ।
রাধাকৃষ্ণ-গুণগান প্রেমায় বিহ্বল ॥ ১৪৩+৪ ॥

naṭabara-śekhara sughaṛa sahacara |
rādhākṛṣṇa-guṇagāna premāẏa bihbala || 143+4 ||

natavara-shekhara — the crest-jewel of dancers; sughada sahachara — [with] skilful companions; radha-krishna-guna-gana — singing the glories of Radha and Krishna; premaya vihvala — overwhelmed by prema

143+4The crest-jewel of dancers, with His skilful companions,
sings the glories of Radha and Krishna, overwhelmed with prema.

হেনই সময়ে কহে ভারতী-গোসাঞি ।
কি নাম তোমার হবে — শুনহ নিমাঞি ॥ ১৪৪ ॥

henai samaẏe kahe bhāratī-gosāñi |
ki nāma tomāra habe — śunaha nimāñi || 144 ||

henai samaye — at that very time; kahe bharati-gosani — Bharati Gosani says; ki nama tomara habe — what will Your name be; shunaha nimanni — listen, Nimai

144At that very time Bharati Gosani says:
"What will Your name be? Listen, Nimai."

যতেক বৈষ্ণবগণ ছিল সেইখানে ।
সভে মিলি' ন্যাসিবর করে অনুমানে ॥ ১৪৫ ॥

yateka baiṣṇabagaṇa chila seikhāne |
sabhe mili' nyāsibara kare anumāne || 145 ||

yateka vaishnava-gana — all the Vaishnavas; chhila sei-khane — who were there; sabhe mili nyasivara — all together with the best of sannyasis; kare anumane — deliberate

145All the Vaishnavas who were there,
together with the best of sannyasis, began to deliberate;

বুদ্ধি-অনুসারে কহে যার যেই মনে ।
হেনকালে শুভবাণী উঠিল গগনে ॥ ১৪৬ ॥

buddhi-anusāre kahe yāra yei mane |
henakāle śubhabāṇī uṭhila gagane || 146 ||

buddhi-anusare kahe — each speaks according to his understanding; yara yei mane — whatever is in his mind; hena-kale — at that time; shubha-vani uthila gagane — an auspicious voice arose in the sky

146each speaks according to his understanding, whatever is in his mind, —
and then an auspicious voice arose in the sky.

ধ্বনি শুনি' সর্বলোক হৈল চমৎকার ।
'শ্রীকৃষ্ণচৈতন্য' নাম করহ ইঁহার ॥ ১৪৭ ॥

dhbani śuni' sarbaloka haila camatkāra |
'śrīkṛṣṇacaitanya' nāma karaha iṁhāra || 147 ||

dhvani shuni — hearing the voice; sarvaloka haila chamatkara — everyone was amazed; shri-krishna-chaitanya — "Sri Krishna Chaitanya"; nama karaha inhara — make His name

147Hearing it, everyone was amazed:
"Give Him the name 'Sri Krishna Chaitanya.'"

নিদ্রারূপা মহামায়া দেবী ভগবতী ।
আচ্ছাদিল সর্বজন — ছন্ন ভেল মতি ॥ ১৪৮ ॥

nidrārūpā mahāmāẏā debī bhagabatī |
ācchādila sarbajana — channa bhela mati || 148 ||

nidra-rupa — in the form of sleep; mahamaya devi bhagavati — Mahamaya, the goddess Bhagavati; achchhadila sarvajana — covered all people; chhanna bhela mati — their minds were clouded

148Mahamaya, the goddess Bhagavati, in the form of sleep,
has enveloped all people — their minds are clouded;

যতেক করয়ে সব নিঁদের স্বপনে ।
আপনে ঠাকুর সভার করায় চেতনে ॥ ১৪৯ ॥

yateka karaẏe saba niṁdera sbapane |
āpane ṭhākura sabhāra karāẏa cetane || 149 ||

yateka karaye saba — all that they do; nindera svapane — [is as] in a dream of sleep; apane thakura — the Lord Himself; sabhara karaya chetane — awakens all

149all that they do is [as] in a dream.
The Lord Himself awakens everyone;

আপনেই কৃষ্ণ — কৃষ্ণ বুঝায় সভারে ।
'শ্রীকৃষ্ণচৈতন্য' তেঞি বলিয়ে ইঁহারে ॥ ১৫০ ॥

āpanei kṛṣṇa — kṛṣṇa bujhāẏa sabhāre |
'śrīkṛṣṇacaitanya' teñi baliẏe iṁhāre || 150 ||

apanei krishna — Himself Krishna; krishna bujhaya sabhare — He makes all understand Krishna; shri-krishna-chaitanya — "Sri Krishna Chaitanya"; tenni baliye inhare — therefore He is called

150being Himself Krishna, He reveals Krishna to all —
therefore He is called "Sri Krishna Chaitanya."11

এতেক বচন যবে দৈবমুখে শুনি ।
আনন্দিত সর্বলোক করে হরিধ্বনি ॥ ১৫১ ॥

eteka bacana yabe daibamukhe śuni |
ānandita sarbaloka kare haridhbani || 151 ||

eteka bachana — these words; yabe daiva-mukhe shuni — when they heard from the mouth of heaven; anandita sarvaloka — all the people, joyful; kare hari-dhvani — raise the cry of "Hari"

151When all heard these words from the mouth of heaven,
the people joyfully raised the cry of Hari's name.

আনন্দ-হৃদয়ে প্রভু বলে হরিবোল ।
'শ্রীকৃষ্ণচৈতন্য নাম আজি হৈতে মোর' ॥ ১৫১+১ ॥

ānanda-hṛdaẏe prabhu bale haribola |
'śrīkṛṣṇacaitanya nāma āji haite mora' || 151+1 ||

ananda-hridaye — with a joyful heart; prabhu bale haribola — the Lord cries "Haribol!"; shri-krishna-chaitanya nama — the name "Sri Krishna Chaitanya"; aji haite mora — is Mine from today

151+1With a joyful heart the Lord cries, "Haribol!":12
"From today My name is Sri Krishna Chaitanya."

গুরুর চরণে করি' প্রণতি বিস্তর ।
প্রদক্ষিণ করিয়া চলয়ে বিশ্বম্ভর ॥ ১৫১+২ ॥

gurura caraṇe kari' praṇati bistara |
pradakṣiṇa kariẏā calaẏe biśbambhara || 151+2 ||

gurura charane kari — making at the guru's feet; pranati vistara — many obeisances; pradakshina kariya — circumambulating [him]; chalaye vishvambhara — Vishvambhara sets out

151+2Bowing many times at the guru's feet,
Vishvambhara circumambulated him and set out.

গমন-উদ্যম দেখি' সেই ন্যাসিরাজ ।
ডাকে — হের, ধর দণ্ড, না করহ ব্যাজ ॥ ১৫১+৩ ॥

gamana-udyama dekhi' sei nyāsirāja |
ḍāke — hera, dhara daṇḍa, nā karaha byāja || 151+3 ||

gamana-udyama dekhi — seeing Him setting off; sei nyasiraja — that king of sannyasis; dake — calls; hera dhara danda — here, take the staff; na karaha byaja — do not delay

151+3Seeing Him leaving, the king of sannyasis
calls: "Here, take the staff, do not delay!"

গুরুর বচন শুনি' লেউটিয়া আসি' ।
গুরু-ঠাঁই দণ্ড পাইয়া লহু লহু হাসি ॥ ১৫১+৪ ॥

gurura bacana śuni' leuṭiẏā āsi' |
guru-ṭhāṁi daṇḍa pāiẏā lahu lahu hāsi || 151+4 ||

gurura bachana shuni — hearing the guru's words; leutiya asi — coming back; guru-thani danda paiya — receiving the staff from the guru; lahu lahu hasi — smiling gently

151+4Hearing the guru's word, [the Lord] came back
and, smiling gently, received the staff from the guru.

সাদরে লৈল প্রভু গুরুর সে দণ্ড ।
প্রণতি করয়ে বহু ভকতি প্রচণ্ড ॥ ১৫১+৫ ॥

sādare laila prabhu gurura se daṇḍa |
praṇati karaẏe bahu bhakati pracaṇḍa || 151+5 ||

sadare laila prabhu — the Lord reverently took; gurura se danda — that staff of the guru; pranati karaye bahu — bows many times; bhakati prachanda — with intense devotion

151+5The Lord reverently accepted the guru's staff
and bowed to him many times with fervent devotion.

তবে সেই মহাপ্রভু বলে হরিবোল ।
উথলিয়া পড়ে মহাপ্রেমার হিল্লোল ॥ ১৫১+৬ ॥

tabe sei mahāprabhu bale haribola |
uthaliẏā paṛe mahāpremāra hillola || 151+6 ||

tabe sei mahaprabhu — then Mahaprabhu; bale haribola — cries "Haribol!"; uthaliya pade — surge up; maha-premara hillola — the waves of great prema

151+6Then Mahaprabhu cries, "Haribol!" —
and the waves of great prema surge up.

গুরুর আজ্ঞায় প্রভু সেদিন তথাই ।
গুরুভক্তি করি' সুখে বঞ্চিলা গোসাঞি ॥ ১৫২ ॥

gurura ājñāẏa prabhu sedina tathāi |
gurubhakti kari' sukhe bañcilā gosāñi || 152 ||

gurura ajnaya — by the guru's order; prabhu sedina tathai — the Lord, that day, right there; guru-bhakti kari — serving the guru; sukhe vanchila gosani — Gosani passed [the time] happily

152By the guru's order the Lord stayed there that day
and spent it happily in service to the guru.

রজনী বৈষ্ণব মিলে করে সংকীর্তন ।
গুরুর সংহতি নৃত্য করয়ে মোহন ॥ ১৫৩ ॥

rajanī baiṣṇaba mile kare saṃkīrtana |
gurura saṃhati nṛtya karaẏe mohana || 153 ||

rajani — at night; vaishnava mile — the Vaishnavas together; kare sankirtana — perform sankirtana; gurura samhati — together with the guru; nritya karaye mohana — [the Lord] dances enchantingly

153At night the Vaishnavas together perform sankirtana;
together with the guru [the Lord] dances enchantingly.

কেশবভারতী নাচে প্রেমানন্দ-সুখে ।
ঠাকুর নাচয়ে, হরি বোলে সর্বলোকে ॥ ১৫৪ ॥

keśababhāratī nāce premānanda-sukhe |
ṭhākura nācaẏe, hari bole sarbaloke || 154 ||

keshava-bharati nache — Keshava Bharati dances; premananda-sukhe — in the joy of prema's bliss; thakura nachaye — the Lord dances; hari bole sarvaloke — everyone cries "Hari!"

154Keshava Bharati dances in the joy of prema's bliss,
the Lord dances, and all the people cry, "Hari!"

প্রেমানন্দে পূর্ণ দোঁহে পাশরে আপনা ।
ব্রহ্মসুখ অল্প করি' মানয়ে দু'জনা ॥ ১৫৫ ॥

premānande pūrṇa doṁhe pāśare āpanā |
brahmasukha alpa kari' mānaẏe du'janā || 155 ||

premanande purna donhe — both, filled with the bliss of prema; pashare apana — forget themselves; brahma-sukha alpa kari — the happiness of Brahman as paltry; manaye du-jana — both regard

155Both, filled with the bliss of prema, forgot themselves;
both regard the happiness of Brahman as paltry.13

এইমতে কতক্ষণে নৃত্য-অবসানে ।
বসিয়া কহয়ে ন্যাসী, বিশ্বম্ভর শুনে ॥ ১৫৫+১ ॥

eimate katakṣaṇe nṛtya-abasāne |
basiẏā kahaẏe nyāsī, biśbambhara śune || 155+1 ||

eimate katakshane — thus after a while; nritya-avasane — when the dancing ended; basiya kahaye nyasi — the sannyasi, sitting down, speaks; vishvambhara shune — Vishvambhara listens

155+1Thus after a while, when the dancing ended,14
the sannyasi sat down and spoke, and Vishvambhara listened:

মোর হাথ হৈতে দণ্ড কে নিল আমার ।
দণ্ডাগ্র পরশি' পুন চাহি নাচিবার ॥ ১৫৫+২ ॥

mora hātha haite daṇḍa ke nila āmāra |
daṇḍāgra paraśi' puna cāhi nācibāra || 155+2 ||

mora hatha haite — from my hand; danda ke nila amara — who took my staff; dandagra parashi — touching the tip of the staff; puna chahi nachibara — I want to dance again

155+2"Who took the staff from my hand?
Touching the tip of the staff, I want to dance again!"

ইহা বলি' বিহ্বল হইয়া নৃত্য করে ।
অতি অপরূপ নাচে প্রেমানন্দ-ভরে ॥ ১৫৫+৩ ॥

ihā bali' bihbala haiẏā nṛtya kare |
ati aparūpa nāce premānanda-bhare || 155+3 ||

iha bali — saying this; vihvala haiya — beside himself; nritya kare — he dances; ati aparupa nache — dances wondrously; premananda-bhare — brimming with the bliss of prema

155+3Saying this, he dances, beside himself —
dances wondrously, brimming with the bliss of prema.

আনন্দে বৈষ্ণব সব নাচয়ে কৌতুকে ।
হরি হরি বলে সব লোক চতুর্দিকে ॥ ১৫৫+৪ ॥

ānande baiṣṇaba saba nācaẏe kautuke |
hari hari bale saba loka caturdike || 155+4 ||

anande vaishnava saba — all the Vaishnavas in bliss; nachaye kautuke — dance joyfully; hari hari bale — cry "Hari, Hari!"; saba loka chaturdike — all the people all around

155+4In bliss all the Vaishnavas dance joyfully,
and all the people around cry, "Hari, Hari!"

এইমতে আনন্দে-সানন্দে রাত্রি যায় ।
প্রভাতে উঠিয়া প্রভু মাগেন বিদায় ॥ ১৫৬ ॥

eimate ānande-sānande rātri yāẏa |
prabhāte uṭhiẏā prabhu māgena bidāẏa || 156 ||

eimate anande-sanande — thus in joy and delight; ratri yaya — the night passes; prabhate uthiya — rising at dawn; prabhu magena vidaya — the Lord asks leave to go

156Thus in joy and delight the night passes;
rising at dawn, the Lord asks leave to go.

গুরু প্রদক্ষিণ করি' করয়ে প্রণাম ।
নীলাচল যাই — যদি পাই সম্বিধান ॥ ১৫৭ ॥

guru pradakṣiṇa kari' karaẏe praṇāma |
nīlācala yāi — yadi pāi sambidhāna || 157 ||

guru pradakshina kari — circumambulating the guru; karaye pranama — He bows; nilachala yai — I shall go to Nilachala; yadi pai samvidhana — if I receive [your] sanction

157Circumambulating the guru, He bows:
"I shall go to Nilachala, if I have your sanction."

গুরুর চরণে আজ্ঞা মাগয়ে ঠাকুর ।
কেশবভারতীর হিয়া করে দুরদুর ॥ ১৫৮ ॥

gurura caraṇe ājñā māgaẏe ṭhākura |
keśababhāratīra hiẏā kare duradura || 158 ||

gurura charane — at the guru's feet; ajna magaye thakura — the Lord asks permission; keshava-bharatira hiya — Keshava Bharati's heart; kare duradura — throbs

158The Lord asks permission at the guru's feet, —
and Keshava Bharati's heart throbs.

ছলছল করে আঁখি করুণার জলে ।
বিদায়-সময়ে গোরাচাঁদে করে কোলে ॥ ১৫৯ ॥

chalachala kare āṁkhi karuṇāra jale |
bidāẏa-samaẏe gorācāṁde kare kole || 159 ||

chhalachhala kare ankhi — his eyes brim; karunara jale — with tears of compassion; vidaya-samaye — at the time of parting; gorachande kare kole — he embraces Gorachand

159His eyes brim with tears of compassion;
at parting he embraces Gorachand:

স্বতন্ত্র ঈশ্বর তুমি আপনার সুখে ।
করুণা-কারণে পদব্রজে বুল লোকে ॥ ১৬০ ॥

sbatantra īśbara tumi āpanāra sukhe |
karuṇā-kāraṇe padabraje bula loke || 160 ||

svatantra ishvara tumi — You are the independent Lord; apanara sukhe — in Your own bliss; karuna-karane — out of compassion; padavraje bula loke — You walk on foot among people

160"You are the independent Lord, [abiding] in Your own bliss;
out of compassion You walk on foot among people.

গুরুভক্তি লওয়াবারে কর বিধিকর্ম ।
সংস্থাপন করিবারে সংকীর্তন-ধর্ম ॥ ১৬১ ॥

gurubhakti laoẏābāre kara bidhikarma |
saṃsthāpana karibāre saṃkīrtana-dharma || 161 ||

guru-bhakti laoyabare — to make people take up devotion to the guru; kara vidhi-karma — You perform the prescribed rites; samsthapana karibare — to establish; sankirtana-dharma — the dharma of sankirtana

161To teach [people] devotion to the guru You perform the prescribed rites,
to establish the dharma of sankirtana.

সর্বলোক নিস্তারিতে করুণা প্রকাশ ।
আমা বিড়ম্বিতে কৈলে এই ত সন্ন্যাস ॥ ১৬২ ॥

sarbaloka nistārite karuṇā prakāśa |
āmā biṛambite kaile ei ta sannyāsa || 162 ||

sarvaloka nistarite — to deliver all people; karuna prakasha — You have shown mercy; ama vidambite — to put me in an awkward place; kaile ei ta sannyasa — You have taken this sannyasa

162To deliver all people You have shown mercy,
and to put me in an awkward place You have taken this sannyasa.15

আমার নিস্তার যেন হয় বিশ্বম্ভর ।
এই মোর বাক্য তুমি পালিহ অন্তর ॥ ১৬৩ ॥

āmāra nistāra yena haẏa biśbambhara |
ei mora bākya tumi pāliha antara || 163 ||

amara nistara yena haya — that I too may be delivered; vishvambhara — Vishvambhara; ei mora vakya — this word of mine; tumi paliha antara — keep in Your heart

163That I too may be delivered, Vishvambhara —
this is my plea; keep it in Your heart."

আজ্ঞা দিল — চল নীলাচল-গিরিরাজে ।
কিছু না বলিল গৌরচন্দ্র আর লাজে ॥ ১৬৩+১ ॥

ājñā dila — cala nīlācala-girirāje |
kichu nā balila gauracandra āra lāje || 163+1 ||

ajna dila — [Bharati] gave leave; chala nilachala-giriraje — go to Nilachala, the king of mountains; kichhu na balila gaurachandra — Gaurachandra said nothing; ara laje — further, out of modesty

163+1[Bharati] gave leave: "Go to Nilachala, the king of mountains,"16
and Gaurachandra, out of modesty, said nothing more.

চরণ পরশ করি' চলিল ঠাকুর ।
পথে যাইতে প্রেমানন্দ বাঢ়িল প্রচুর ॥ ১৬৪ ॥

caraṇa paraśa kari' calila ṭhākura |
pathe yāite premānanda bāṛhila pracura || 164 ||

charana parasha kari — touching [his] feet; chalila thakura — the Lord set out; pathe yaite — as He went on the road; premananda badhila prachura — the bliss of prema grew abundantly

164Touching his feet, the Lord set out;
on the road the bliss of prema grew beyond measure.

কৃষ্ণ কৃষ্ণ বলি' ডাকে প্রেমার উল্লাস ।
ক্ষণেকে রোদন, ক্ষণে অট্ট-অট্ট হাস ॥ ১৬৫ ॥

kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa bali' ḍāke premāra ullāsa |
kṣaṇeke rodana, kṣaṇe aṭṭa-aṭṭa hāsa || 165 ||

krishna krishna bali dake — He calls "Krishna, Krishna!"; premara ullasa — in the exultation of prema; kshaneke rodana — now weeping; kshane atta-atta hasa — now loud laughter

165In the exultation of prema He calls, "Krishna, Krishna!" —
now He weeps, now He laughs aloud.

বুক বাঞা পড়ে ধারা নয়নের জলে ।
সুরনদী-ধারা যেন সুমেরু-শিখরে ॥ ১৬৬ ॥

buka bāñā paṛe dhārā naẏanera jale |
suranadī-dhārā yena sumeru-śikhare || 166 ||

buka vanya pade dhara — streams run down His chest; nayanera jale — of tears from His eyes; sura-nadi-dhara yena — like the stream of the celestial river; sumeru-shikhare — on the peak of Sumeru

166Streams of tears run down His chest —
like the stream of the celestial river down the peak of Sumeru.

কদম্ব-কেশর জিনি' বিপুল পুলক ।
কণ্টকিত সর্ব অঙ্গ আপাদমস্তক ॥ ১৬৭ ॥

kadamba-keśara jini' bipula pulaka |
kaṇṭakita sarba aṅga āpādamastaka || 167 ||

kadamba-keshara jini — surpassing the filaments of the kadamba; vipula pulaka — abundant thrill; kantakita sarva anga — His whole body bristles; apada-mastaka — from feet to head

167His abundant thrill surpasses the filaments of the kadamba:
His whole body bristles from head to foot.

মত্ত করিবর যেন রঙ্গে চলি' যায় ।
নির্ভর প্রেমায় ক্ষণে কৃষ্ণ বলি' গায় ॥ ১৬৮ ॥

matta karibara yena raṅge cali' yāẏa |
nirbhara premāẏa kṣaṇe kṛṣṇa bali' gāẏa || 168 ||

matta karivara yena — like an intoxicated elephant; range chali yaya — He moves along playfully; nirbhara premaya — in boundless prema; kshane krishna bali gaya — now He sings "Krishna!"

168He moves along playfully like an intoxicated elephant;
in boundless prema now He sings "Krishna!",

ক্ষণেকে পড়য়ে ভূমি রহে স্তব্ধ হঞা ।
ক্ষণে লম্ফ দিয়া উঠে হরিবোল বলিয়া ॥ ১৬৯ ॥

kṣaṇeke paṛaẏe bhūmi rahe stabdha hañā |
kṣaṇe lampha diẏā uṭhe haribola baliẏā || 169 ||

kshaneke padaye bhumi — now He falls to the ground; rahe stabdha hanya — and lies stunned; kshane lampha diya uthe — now He springs up; haribola baliya — crying "Haribol!"

169now He falls to the ground and lies stunned,
now He springs up crying, "Haribol!"

ক্ষণে গোপিকার ভাব, ক্ষণে দাস্যভাব ।
ক্ষণে ধীরে ধীরে চলে, ক্ষণে শীঘ্র ধাব ॥ ১৭০ ॥

kṣaṇe gopikāra bhāba, kṣaṇe dāsyabhāba |
kṣaṇe dhīre dhīre cale, kṣaṇe śīghra dhāba || 170 ||

kshane gopikara bhava — now the bhava of a gopi; kshane dasya-bhava — now the bhava of a servant; kshane dhire dhire chale — now He walks slowly; kshane shighra dhava — now He runs swiftly

170Now the bhava of a gopi is in Him, now the bhava of a servant;17
now He walks slowly, now He runs swiftly.

এইমতে দিবারাত্রি না জানে আনন্দে ।
রাঢ়দেশে না শুনিল কৃষ্ণনাম-গন্ধে ॥ ১৭১ ॥

eimate dibārātri nā jāne ānande |
rāṛhadeśe nā śunila kṛṣṇanāma-gandhe || 171 ||

eimate — thus; divaratri na jane anande — in bliss He knows neither day nor night; radha-deshe — in Radha-desha; na shunila krishna-nama-gandhe — He did not hear even a trace of Krishna's name

171Thus in bliss He knows neither day nor night.
In Radha-desha He did not hear even a trace of Krishna's name,18

কৃষ্ণনাম না শুনিঞা খেদ উঠে চিতে ।
নিশ্চয় করিল জলে প্রবেশ করিতে ॥ ১৭২ ॥

kṛṣṇanāma nā śuniñā kheda uṭhe cite |
niścaẏa karila jale prabeśa karite || 172 ||

krishna-nama na shuninya — not hearing Krishna's name; kheda uthe chite — grief arose in His heart; nishchaya karila — He resolved; jale pravesha karite — to enter the water

172and, not hearing Krishna's name, He was filled with grief
and resolved to enter the water.19

দেখি' সব ভক্তগণ করে অনুতাপ ।
গৌরাঙ্গ গোলোকে যায় — কি হবে রে বাপ ॥ ১৭৩ ॥

dekhi' saba bhaktagaṇa kare anutāpa |
gaurāṅga goloke yāẏa — ki habe re bāpa || 173 ||

dekhi saba bhakta-gana — seeing this, all the devotees; kare anutapa — lament; gauranga goloke yaya — Gauranga is going to Goloka; ki habe re bapa — alas, what will happen

173Seeing this, all the devotees lament:
"Gauranga is going to Goloka! Alas, what will become of us!"

তবে নিত্যানন্দ প্রভু বোলে বীরদাপে ।
রাখিব চৈতন্য আমি আপন প্রতাপে ॥ ১৭৪ ॥

tabe nityānanda prabhu bole bīradāpe |
rākhiba caitanya āmi āpana pratāpe || 174 ||

tabe nityananda prabhu — then Nityananda Prabhu; bole vira-dape — says with a hero's boldness; rakhiba chaitanya ami — I shall keep Chaitanya [here]; apana pratape — by my own power

174Then Nityananda Prabhu says with a hero's boldness:
"By my own power I shall keep Chaitanya here."

সেইখানে শিশুগণ গোধন চরায় ।
নিত্যানন্দ প্রভু তার প্রবেশে হিয়ায় ॥ ১৭৫ ॥

seikhāne śiśugaṇa godhana carāẏa |
nityānanda prabhu tāra prabeśe hiẏāẏa || 175 ||

sei-khane shishugana — there some boys; godhana charaya — are grazing cows; nityananda prabhu — Nityananda Prabhu; tara praveshe hiyaya — enters their hearts

175There some boys were grazing cows —
Nityananda Prabhu entered their hearts.

নিশ্চয় করিয়া গেলা জলের সমীপ ।
হরি বলি' এক শিশু ডাকে আচম্বিত ॥ ১৭৬ ॥

niścaẏa kariẏā gelā jalera samīpa |
hari bali' eka śiśu ḍāke ācambita || 176 ||

nishchaya kariya — having resolved; gela jalera samipa — [the Lord] went near the water; hari bali — "Hari!"; eka shishu dake achambita — one boy suddenly calls out

176When [the Lord], resolved, went near the water,
one boy suddenly called out, "Hari!"

তাহা শুনি' লেউটি' আইলা গৌরহরি ।
'বোল বোল' বোলে, ডাকে শিশু-হস্ত ধরি' ॥ ১৭৭ ॥

tāhā śuni' leuṭi' āilā gaurahari |
'bola bola' bole, ḍāke śiśu-hasta dhari' || 177 ||

taha shuni — hearing this; leuti aila gaurahari — Gaurahari turned back; bola bola bole — says "Say it, say it!"; dake shishu-hasta dhari — calls, holding the boy's hand

177Hearing this, Gaurahari turned back
and, holding the boy's hand, urges him: "Say it, say it [again]!

তোমারে করুন কৃপা প্রভু ভগবান্ ।
কৃতার্থ করিলে শুনাইয়া হরিনাম ॥ ১৭৮ ॥

tomāre karuna kṛpā prabhu bhagabān |
kṛtārtha karile śunāiẏā harināma || 178 ||

tomare karuna kripa — may He show you mercy; prabhu bhagavan — the Lord Bhagavan; kritartha karile — you have fulfilled [Me]; shunaiya hari-nama — by letting Me hear the name of Hari

178May the Lord Bhagavan be merciful to you:
you have blessed Me by letting Me hear the name of Hari."

প্রেমানন্দে ভাসে প্রভু আনন্দিত হিয়া ।
ভিক্ষা করিলা প্রভু কথোদূর গিয়া ॥ ১৭৯ ॥

premānande bhāse prabhu ānandita hiẏā |
bhikṣā karilā prabhu kathodūra giẏā || 179 ||

premanande bhase prabhu — the Lord floats in the bliss of prema; anandita hiya — with a joyful heart; bhiksha karila prabhu — the Lord took alms; kathodura giya — after going some distance

179The Lord floats in the bliss of prema, His heart rejoicing;
going on a little further, the Lord took alms.

হেনমতে দিবানিশি নাহি জানে সুখে ।
তিন দিন বহি' অন্নজল দিল মুখে ॥ ১৮০ ॥

henamate dibāniśi nāhi jāne sukhe |
tina dina bahi' annajala dila mukhe || 180 ||

henamate — thus; divanishi nahi jane sukhe — in bliss He knew neither day nor night; tina dina bahi — only after three days; anna-jala dila mukhe — He put food and water in His mouth

180Thus in bliss He knew neither day nor night —
only after three days did He take food and water.

হেনমতে প্রেমানন্দে দিনরাতি যায় ।
চন্দ্রশেখর-আচার্যে দিলেন বিদায় ॥ ১৮১ ॥

henamate premānande dinarāti yāẏa |
candraśekhara-ācārye dilena bidāẏa || 181 ||

henamate — thus; premanande dinarati yaya — days and nights pass in the bliss of prema; chandrashekhara-acharye — Chandrashekhara Acharya; dilena vidaya — He dismissed

181Thus days and nights passed in the bliss of prema.
[Then the Lord] dismissed Chandrashekhara Acharya:

নবদ্বীপবাসী যত আমার লাগিয়া ।
কান্দয়ে ব্যাকুল হৈয়া ডাকিয়া ডাকিয়া ॥ ১৮১+১ ॥

nabadbīpabāsī yata āmāra lāgiẏā |
kāndaẏe byākula haiẏā ḍākiẏā ḍākiẏā || 181+1 ||

navadvipa-vasi yata — all the people of Navadvipa; amara lagiya — for Me; kandaye byakula haiya — weep in distress; dakiya dakiya — calling and calling

181+1"All the people of Navadvipa20
weep for Me in distress and keep calling Me.

নিশ্চয় না জানে মোর সন্ন্যাস-করণ ।
সভারে জানাহ মোর এই বিবরণ ॥ ১৮১+২ ॥

niścaẏa nā jāne mora sannyāsa-karaṇa |
sabhāre jānāha mora ei bibaraṇa || 181+2 ||

nishchaya na jane — they do not know for certain; mora sannyasa-karana — that I have taken sannyasa; sabhare janaha — tell everyone; mora ei vivarana — this account of Mine

181+2They do not know for certain that I have taken sannyasa:
tell them all this account of Me."

কহিল ঠাকুর — পুনঃ হৈব দরশন ।
অচিরে হইবে দেখা, না হও বিমন ॥ ১৮২ ॥

kahila ṭhākura — punaḥ haiba daraśana |
acire haibe dekhā, nā hao bimana || 182 ||

kahila thakura — the Lord said; punah haiba darashana — we shall see each other again; achire haibe dekha — soon we shall meet; na hao vimana — do not be downcast

182The Lord said: "We shall see each other again;
soon we shall meet — do not be downcast."

এ বোল বলিয়া প্রভু চলিলা সত্বর ।
কান্দিতে কান্দিতে যায় শ্রীচন্দ্রশেখর ॥ ১৮৩ ॥

e bola baliẏā prabhu calilā satbara |
kāndite kāndite yāẏa śrīcandraśekhara || 183 ||

e bola baliya — saying this; prabhu chalila satvara — the Lord went on quickly; kandite kandite yaya — weeping, goes; shri-chandrashekhara — Sri Chandrashekhara

183Saying this, the Lord went on quickly,
and Sri Chandrashekhara goes away weeping:

মরিব মরিব প্রভু তোমা না দেখিয়া ।
মরিব যে নবদ্বীপের শোকার্ণবে পড়িয়া ॥ ১৮৩+১ ॥

mariba mariba prabhu tomā nā dekhiẏā |
mariba ye nabadbīpera śokārṇabe paṛiẏā || 183+1 ||

mariba mariba prabhu — I shall die, I shall die, Lord; toma na dekhiya — not seeing You; mariba ye — I shall surely die; navadvipera shokarnave padiya — fallen into Navadvipa's ocean of grief

183+1"I shall die, I shall die, Lord, not seeing You,21
I shall die, fallen into Navadvipa's ocean of grief!"

হেথা নবদ্বীপবাসী একমুখে রহে ।
